steps.title: Check the objective
steps.prompt: Fit the objective that is in the light path, and focus on a textured part of the sample. Two small moves check that the image moves as that objective's should.

steps.title: Calibrate the geometry
steps.prompt: Keep a textured part of the sample in focus, with room around it for moves of a quarter of the field each way.

steps.title: Take a dark frame
steps.prompt: Lights that can be switched are turned off for the dark frame, and back on. Block any other light from reaching the camera.

steps.title: Take a flat field
steps.prompt: Move to a blank part of the slide, clear glass with nothing on it, in focus, with the light on as it will be used.

steps.title: Calibrate colour
steps.prompt: Load the colour target, and centre it in the field of the 5× or the 10×, in focus, with the light on as it will be used.

steps.title: Calibrate the stage
steps.prompt: Bring a textured part of the sample back into view, in focus: the stage measures its backlash there, then homes, and comes back.
